messages:
Maya: Heads up — prepping nova-lite-13b for hosted onboarding. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/nova-lite-13b/v1/ but we need a safetensors conversion + shard-layout validation before we can stage. Can someone do a quick QC?
Sam: I pulled the bucket. Files look like model-00001-of-00016.safetensors ...00016 and tokenizer.json. Size seems right, but convert script failed earlier with an fp16 header mismatch. I'll re-run with explicit dtype.
Jun: Quick note: tokenizer.json has bos_token_id: -1 (legacy). That breaks our tokenizer wrapper on load. Either remap to a positive id (1) or set add_bos=true in the model config.
Priya: If you're converting, please use --dtype bf16 to match training parity. Also ensure manifest has 'shard_map' and indicates tensor-parallel layout tp=2 (our serving runtime expects tp=2 for 13B class).
Theo: Pinged code review for the conversion script changes: https://git.internal/redwood/runtimes/packaging/pull/432 — @Sam can you include a sample inference json + golden output so QA can smoke-test?
Sam: Running: ```./tools/convert_to_safetensors.sh s3://redwood-models/nova-lite-13b/v1 --dtype bf16 --shard-count 16 --tp 2```
infra-bot: Build started: conversion-job-2241000000 (CI job 9821). Logs: https://ci.redwood/9821
Sam: CI failed at step 'safetensors header check' — checksum mismatch on model-00005-of-00016. Error: "expected bytes 0x12 != found 0x00"
Jun: Could be multipart upload corruption. Sam, can you `aws s3 cp` the shard locally and check md5/etag? Our tools have a fallback: `tools/reassemble_shard.py --path s3://... --part 5` which helped before.
Sam: Re-uploading shard 00005 with singlepart upload now, then will re-run convert and post logs.
Priya: Also add a small metadata block in the model card for tokenizer special tokens to avoid runtime hacks: "\"special_tokens\": {\"bos_token\": \"<s>\", \"bos_token_id\": \"1\"}"
Theo: Left comments in the PR about adding a unit test for negative special token ids. Can someone add a small unpack/test step in the packaging pipeline so this doesn't slip again?
ci-bot: Job 9821 retried by @Sam — running smoke tests.
Sam: Smoke passed. Pushed updated safetensors and manifest. Small sample inference uploaded: s3://redwood-ci-results/2241000000/sample_out.json (prompt: "Hello", max_new_tokens:16).
Maya: Great. @Jun can you follow up with the tokenizer-mapping PR? @Theo will you merge when green? I'll schedule a deploy window tomorrow 09:30 PT to stage if everything is green. :thumbsup:
Jun: On it — opening PR for tokenizer mapping in ~15m.
Theo: OK — will merge once CI is green and the sample checks look good. :ok_hand:
infra-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2024-11-03T09:30:00-07:00 to staging cluster 'staging-us-west1' by @Maya
Sam: One more note — we had to flip kv-cache ordering in the manifest (kv_order: 'pv2') to match runtime expectation. Verified local smoke.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll post a short runbook in docs/ with the final S3 paths, manifest changes, and notes after deploy.
